literal_meaning: বুকে ঢেঁকির কিনারা পড়া (the edge of a dhunki falling on the chest)
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবর শুনে তার বুকে ঢেঁকির পাড় পড়ল।
অন্যায় দেখে আমার বুকে ঢেঁকির পাড় পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the news, his blood became restless.
Seeing the injustice made my blood boil.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali life where a dhunki (a traditional wooden pestle for pounding rice) is used; the sharp edge falling on one's chest symbolizes sudden pain and agitation, metaphorically representing emotional turmoil.
note: Dhunki is a tool deeply embedded in agrarian Bengali culture.
